## Overview
Builderforce.ai is an AI agent platform for building, running, and integrating coding/chat agents across channels and IDEs. Stack is mostly TypeScript/TSX (Node, React), plus SQL, Swift (macOS/iOS), and some Go; Cloudflare Workers (Wrangler) and Docker appear in deploy paths.

agent-runtime hosts the core agent, channel plugins (Slack, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, etc.), memory, UI, and skills. api is the backend/services layer. frontend and docs-site are web apps. studio/studio-embedded and brain-embedded are authoring/embedded agent UIs. sdk, browser-sdk, feedback-sdk, and packages/* share contracts, tools, and TUI bits. clients/vscode is the editor extension. webdit is a web/runtime toolchain. voice, worker, qa-e2e, and container variants cover voice, jobs, tests, and sandboxes.
